findings: Normal Q versus training-mean U:PC+0.125,2wins14ties0loss onVP004/015, allSAidentical, PCpass7to9 andJoint5same.
Unrelated reasoning has equal or better PC on both of these cases:VP0044same,VP0155versusnormal4. Thus the two meanU wins do not yet identify correct reasoning as the helpful information.
MeanU fixes both CFG updates while unrelated changes only positive reasoning; these are different interventions, not interchangeable estimates of one causal effect.
Training meanU has positive/negative RMS.84761/.68219 versus per-inputRMS~1; no additional amplitude or seed control is authorized for this unsuccessful R8 candidate.

Normal versus off:PC+0.125,2wins14ties0loss onVP004/010; SA-0.0625 dueVP010; Joint5same. The physical branch has limited netPC utility on this subset, with one semantic loss, but correct versus unrelated remainsunproven and full40 remainsbelowR1.

Normal versus fixed full-C means:PC+0.0625,1win15ties0loss; SA-0.0625,0wins15ties1loss. Both changes are VP010 (meanC SA4/PC3 -> normal SA3/PC4), Joint5same; other15 cases have identical discrete scores.

This single-case SA/PC exchange establishes sensitivity, not a broad benefit from correct physical reasoning. It is distinct from the2-case normal/off PC gain and from the negative normal/unrelated comparison. Training meanC also has lower RMS; no extra amplitude controls are added.
Normal versus anchor-only:allSAidentical; PC+0.0625,2wins13ties1loss (+VP004/0153to4,-VP0265to4), CI[-0.125,0.25]. PCpasses7to9,Joint5same.

Anchor-only versus off:PC+0.0625,2wins13ties1loss (+VP010/026,-VP015); SA-0.0625onlyVP010. Thus normalQ recoversVP015anchor damage back to offPC4, addsVP004, and removesVP026anchorPC5gain. Fullnormal/offbenefit isVP004/010, withVP010SAcost.

Training-meanU versus anchor-only changes onlyVP026PC5to4; allSAidentical. Sample-specificU addsVP004/015 relative to this fixedupdate, but unrelated reasoning already matches/exceeds normalPC onthese cases.

Final R8 decision:do not replace R1 or extend R8. There is limited input-dependent Q/branch PC benefit on16, but full40 PC3.475 is below R1-4003.625 and normal reasoning does not beat unrelated. Keep reader evidence as a hypothesis for the matched-R1 R9 experiment, not a solved physics-conditioning claim.
